source_document_text:
ANSWER AND COUNTERCLAIM
Plaintiff and counterclaim defendant Larkspur Process Controls LLC alleges that defendant and counterclaim plaintiff Rillstone Packaging Systems, Inc. failed to pay invoices for services under a March 12, 2024 agreement and seeks payment of the alleged balance. Rillstone admits that it entered into the agreement and that Larkspur performed the stated services, but denies that the invoices are presently payable in full. Rillstone alleges that it supplied three production molds for use in the work and that the agreement identifies the molds as Rillstone's property. The parties ended the work on September 30, 2024. Rillstone alleges that Larkspur retained the three molds after the work ended, despite Rillstone's written demand for their return on October 8, 2024. Larkspur contends that it may retain the molds until the invoice dispute is resolved. Rillstone denies that the agreement permits that retention. In its counterclaim, Rillstone requests return of the three molds or, if they cannot be returned, their alleged replacement value of $38,000, and seeks $12,500 in storage and handling losses attributed to the retention.
